prompts.gathering.png:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent PNG illustration for a Haiti road-safety mobile app, readable at 80–156px. Match the established illustrated app assets: polished colorful semi-3D cartoon, clean dark navy contours, smoothly shaded rounded volumes, warm highlights, crisp silhouette, small friendly adult characters, detailed yet simple. Dark-skinned Haitian adults in everyday clothing. Teal, turquoise, warm coral, blue and yellow accents. Centered compact isolated composition in a square with generous transparent margin. Actual transparent alpha background. No lettering, text, slogans, logos, watermark, border, backdrop or circular badge. Peaceful, neutral, observational representation.
Primary request: A compact group of six peaceful people gathered together, three in front and three behind, two holding upright blank rectangular placards. Visually clear illustration for the Rassemblement category. All people fully visible, no weapons or violence.
